model: S4 Wave 1 / S1 — XO high-precision replay (cheap probe)
experiment: S1: determine whether the observed XO numerical behavior (plateau-like d_t, narrow discrepancy band, selection concentration, rebound counts, numerical-boundary riding) is robust under higher precision arithmetic
nature: validation task, not theory development; target evidence class = Verified Numerical Analysis (high precision); no theorem upgrades
pre_registration: This config was written in full BEFORE any S1 computation ran. All tiers, feasibility gates, comparison quantities and decision rules below are frozen; no post-hoc tuning.
planning_source: docs/STAGE4_RESEARCH_MAP.md S1 (PROPOSED, registered a41fd49); this round's frozen prompt = Owner Stage 4 Wave 1 S1 brief. Deviation from the map registered in RESEARCH_LOG: the map deemed an exact-rational replay infeasible ('near-CDF has radicals'), but the radical lives only in the ppf (Monte-Carlo path, unused by the deterministic expected-mass model); cdf(q_near, x) = 2x - x^2 and the XO CDF are rational-valued at every rational edge j/K, so bin probabilities are exactly rational at all execution K and an exact Fraction tier IS feasible. It is added as the X tier; the map's mpmath ladder is kept unchanged.

subject.initial_state: canonical q_near bin probabilities (identical for XO/KC at a given K; exact tier uses the exact rational vector; float/mp tiers use their own arithmetic)
subject.horizon_rule: H(K) = 10*K active rounds or exact stop, whichever first; censored recorded as such, never extended
subject.invariant_anchor: m = ceil(5K/6), b = m/K, anchor = b*(1-b) (Pack v0.3/v0.4 Model-derived Mathematical Result; verified computationally per round in the X tier, never upgraded by this round)

F_float64.definition: the current committed numpy float64 implementation (run_m1a_deterministic + committed Gate-1/Gate-2 per-round diagnostics), regenerated through the committed runner modules
F_float64.validation: STAGE V: every active round must be string-identical against the committed per_round_diagnostics.csv of Gate 2 (XO rows) and Gate 1 (KC rows); committed CSV sha256 must match the recorded metadata.json output hashes; any mismatch halts the round before any precision work
F_float64.role: comparison baseline = the committed float64 record (no duplicate CSV written)

P50_mpmath_dps50.definition: mpmath mp.dps=50, same mathematical semantics, no renormalization of bin probs

P100_mpmath_dps100.definition: mpmath mp.dps=100, same mathematical semantics, no renormalization of bin probs

X_exact_fraction.definition: fractions.Fraction exact real-arithmetic replay; exact rational bin probs (CDF evaluated on exact rational edges, telescoping sum asserted == 1 exactly); exact rational tolerance 1/10^12; exact strict rebound comparison; exact tie flag worst == 0

feasibility_gates_frozen.rule: sequential wall-clock gates measured on the previous K's completed exact replay; on gate failure the K is skipped for the X tier and recorded as 'exact tier not computed (gate)', with P100 as the highest available tier at that K

X_exact_fraction.KC_scope: KC X tier at K=50 only (sanity: exact t_stop vs float 324)

per_round_diagnostics_all_tiers: e_t = d_t - b(1-b) (excess vs invariant anchor)
worst_t = max_j E_t(j), E = M*Delta - gamma (same composition as kernel_theory.rebound_residual / target_matched_excess)
R_t = max over {j: gamma_j > 0} of M*max(Delta_j,0)/gamma_j (guard 0; same index set as committed runners)
exact tie flag worst_t == 0 (X tier only)
rebound flag = strict d_{t+1} > d_t (post-hoc, no tolerance)
X tier additionally: exact invariant check D_{t,m} == b(1-b) as Fraction equality, selection bound s_t <= m, stop-rule check d_t > 1/10^12 for every pre-stop round

comparisons_frozen.selection_itinerary: F vs P50, F vs P100, P100 vs X, F vs X: first divergence round, divergent round count (XO: full H rounds; KC: common prefix)
comparisons_frozen.rebound_flags: per-round strict-flag agreement between every tier pair; N_R per tier; mismatch rounds cross-referenced against |worst| level
comparisons_frozen.scalar_tolerance: d_t/e_t/M/worst/R agreement threshold for 'same value' = |diff| <= 1e-12 absolute OR <= 1e-9 relative (diagnostic only; classification uses the frozen category rules below)

category_rules.Robust: agrees across every available tier (identical sequences/flags for discrete quantities; within scalar_tolerance for continuous diagnostics) — reported as robust across the tested ladder, never as an exact real-arithmetic proof (X tier closeness is evidence about float behavior, not a new theorem)
category_rules.Precision-sensitive: any tier pair disagrees on a classification-relevant value (selection sequence, rebound flag pattern, stop status, N_R, boundary/tie structure)
category_rules.Unknown: neither of the above decidable at the available tiers (e.g. tier gap at K=400 plus F-vs-P disagreement)

comparisons_frozen.boundary_vs_tie: float numerical-boundary share (497/500, 199/1000, 1997/2000, 799/4000 committed) compared against X-tier exact-tie count (worst == 0) and the exact |worst| distribution; no relabeling of the committed float records

itinerary_analysis_frozen.scope: XO only, all tiers; minimal description, explicitly NOT symbolic-dynamics theory (S10 stays parked)
quantities: number of distinct s values; top-10 s values by visit count
longest dwell run and dwell-run distribution (runs of identical consecutive s)
top-10 consecutive transition pairs s_t -> s_{t+1}
F-vs-X itinerary identity (selection stability under precision)

kc_sanity_frozen.expectation_under_test: float KC t_stop = 324/699/1445/2876 at K=50/100/200/400 (committed Gate 1); a P100 or X divergence is a finding to report, not an error to fix
kc_sanity_frozen.checks: float string regeneration (STAGE V); P100 @ all four K; X @ K=50

out_of_scope: no new redistribution laws, no parameter sweeps, no 2D models, no physical experiments
no general asymptotic theory, no symbolic dynamics formalization
no reinterpretation edits of committed Gate-1/Gate-2 records

committed CSV sha256 does not match recorded metadata hash

X tier: any exact invariant violation (D_{t,m} != b(1-b)), any s_t > m, or any d_t <= 1/10^12 before a recorded stop — these would contradict the registered Model-derived Mathematical Result and halt interpretation
